composition_rule: The effective direct projection is the fully composed awa-hook-owner/v1 through awa-hook-owner/v3 role set plus the three roles declared here. Registration roles do not supersede or authorize guard, finish, cleanup, active-root, or ADR 0020 alert behavior.
activation_rule: CATCH_ALL requires an official preToolUse contract plus exact-build live discriminator receipts for ordinary, MCP, renamed, unknown, and Task launch tools. ENUMERATED requires exact installed inventory including every Task/subagent launch discriminator. Missing Task receivability yields HOOK_UNSUPPORTED and no WRITABLE activation.
external_rule: External ownership is rejected before registration receipt construction or persistence. The external host remains sole owner of the selected hook file; AWA does not read, stat, render, back up, chmod, write, or remove it.
